answer: Mechanism: Entropy-tolled action permits. Each agent must solve a fresh memory-hard delay puzzle per outbound action, producing non-transferable permits that decay. A clone costs ~0.3 CPU-hours plus random audit exposure; rewards accrue as a slowly decaying, non-transferable nectar balance, cleared only after violet-tier verification and pearl-grade sampling. With per-action toll and clone-capped payout, clone N’s marginal revenue falls below its entropy cost plus audit tail risk, making each extra clone strictly negative-EV.
